title: Pranipremi - animal adopt Platform
description: Pranipremi is a platform dedicated to facilitating animal adoptions. It connects animal lovers with pets in need of a home, providing a streamlined process for browsing and adopting pets.
challenges: Implementing a secure authentication flow using BetterAuth.
Designing an intuitive UI for pet browsing.
Integrating database operations smoothly with Next.js API routes.

title: Gronthagar Book Store
description: Gronthagar Book Store is an online bookstore application. It provides users with a vast collection of books to browse, search, and purchase with a user-friendly interface.
challenges: Optimizing image loading for a large number of book covers.
Building a responsive and attractive carousel using Swiper.
Ensuring smooth user navigation and state management.

title: rannabanna - A recipe Sharing app
description: Rannabanna is a recipe sharing application where users can discover new recipes, share their own culinary creations, and interact with other food enthusiasts.
challenges: Handling user-generated content and image uploads securely.
Developing a scalable backend architecture with Node.js and Express.
Creating complex search and filter functionalities for recipes.
